subject: FinOptics evaluation: security roadmap & staging checks
messages:
From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@finoptics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finoptics.com
Date: 2028-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation kickoff + MAP request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — FinOptics is interested in running a focused evaluation for payment-safeguarded flows. Our security and legal teams asked that we put a short mutual action plan (MAP) together that calls out the security/compliance gates (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ, DPA items), evidence we need to see, and a suggested close timeline. Can Redwood share a starter MAP and a snapshot of SOC 2 coverage (controls summary) and SIG responses?

Key constraints on our side:
- EU data residency options are required for production (we'll use hosted in us for the eval but need plan for EU).
- Data retention must support 90-day retention for PII logs and a 12-month archival option.
- We have a short procurement window — hoping to close by end of June.

Looping in security@finoptics.com here for any immediate compliance questions.

Thanks,
Liam Chen
Director of Payments, FinOptics
liam.chen@finoptics.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@finoptics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-03T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff + MAP request

Hi Liam — great to meet you yesterday. Attaching a concise MAP that maps security gates to checkpoint owners and a proposed 6-week evaluation timeline. Attachment: MAP_FinOptics_Redwood_v1.pdf (pdf)

Highlights and immediate answers:
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains a Type II SOC 2 report (confidential summary attached: SOC2-summary.pdf). We can share a redacted full report under an NDA.
- SIG/CAIQ: We've completed a CAIQ matrix; I pulled a current export into the attached spreadsheet (SIG-CAIQ-responses.xlsx).
- DPA/data retention: Our standard DPA supports configurable retention windows; for the eval we can set logs to 90 days and enable an archival TTL of 12 months. We can add an EU residency clause if you plan to pilot regional hosting.

Proposed MAP lanes (high level):
1) Security intake: FinOptics sends priority questions (week 1) — Redwood provides evidence and CAIQ answers (week 1–2).
2) Technical POC: sandbox access + sample dataset (week 2–4).
3) Acceptance testing: SOC2-relevant control checks and data flow review (week 4–5).
4) Contract & DPA finalization: legal redlines and sign-off (week 5–6).

Next steps I suggest:
- Quick sync (30m) with your security team this week to confirm evidence list and EU residency requirements.
- I'll flag Neha (legal) and Mateo (technical PM) to help with contract and POC setup.

Would Thursday or Friday work for a security sync?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@finoptics.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-03T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff + MAP request

Looping in Legal next steps — quick note: if FinOptics needs the full SOC 2 report we will request an NDA + limited-use confidentiality addendum. Also recommend we pre-clear the EU residency language so engineering can scope region-based deployment.

- Action for FinOptics legal: share any mandatory DPA clauses you require (EU addendum, subprocessor list conditions).
- Action for Redwood: I will prepare a DPA draft with an EU data residency option and retention SLA.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: security@finoptics.com <security@finoptics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-05T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff + MAP request

Hi Marissa / Neha / Mateo — thanks for the MAP. A few clarifying questions from our security team after reviewing the attachments:

1) SOC 2 scope: does Redwood's SOC 2 Type II cover hosting, network controls, and change management for your hosted API (we need explicit mapping of controls to the hosted service).
2) SIG responses: there are a few "in-progress" items in the CAIQ export around key management and encryption-at-rest configuration. Can you confirm current KMS integrations (AWS KMS, customer-managed keys, HSM options)?
3) Data residency: For production we require EU-hosted keys and data. For the eval we can accept US hosting if logs containing PII are retained only per the 90-day requirement and scrubbed from backups immediately. Is there a guaranteed purge path and proof-of-deletion process?
4) DPA: please confirm standard subprocessors and whether Redwood will accept an addendum for a regulated-data clause.

We'd like the evidence pack (redacted SOC2, CAIQ answers, sample KMS setup doc) by next Tuesday so our procurement can stay on the June close path.

Thanks,
FinOptics Security
security@finoptics.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: security@finoptics.com <security@finoptics.com>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@finoptics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-10T16:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff + MAP request

Hi — thanks for the precise asks. Short answers + attachments/links below:

1) SOC 2 scope: Yes — our SOC 2 Type II covers the hosted API control domains (security, availability, confidentiality). I've attached the controls-mapping extract in SOC2-summary.pdf and dropped the redacted full report into the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP-FinOptics (access: finoptics@finoptics.com).

2) KMS/encryption: Redwood supports AWS KMS and we offer customer-managed key (CMK) options for Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted we support Bring-Your-Key via an HSM/KMS escrow integration; see attached SIG-CAIQ-responses.xlsx sheet "KMS_notes".

3) Purge & deletion: We expose an API for data deletion and provide a documented proof-of-deletion manifest for PII-bearing logs. For the eval: we will configure sandbox with a 90-day log TTL and an immediate backup retention expunge policy; our infra team will produce a one-time deletion confirmation after the eval.

4) DPA & subprocessors: Draft DPA with EU addendum attached — Neha will share a DocuSign template (https://app.docusign.com/templates/FinOptics-MAP-2028). Subprocessor list included in the Drive folder.

Attachments: MAP_FinOptics_Redwood_v1.pdf, SOC2-summary.pdf, SIG-CAIQ-responses.xlsx
Next steps:
- I'll schedule a 30m security sync for Thursday 2028-05-12 at 10:00 AM PT — invite to follow.
- Mateo will provision the sandbox and a short POC data-runbook (expected by 2028-05-15).

If you'd prefer earlier access to the redacted SOC 2 report under NDA, tell me and Neha will route the agreement.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[Attachment stubs: MAP_FinOptics_Redwood_v1.pdf (pdf); SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf); SIG-CAIQ-responses.xlsx (xlsx)]
